claims: Agathe Laisne won the 2026 Joburg Ladies Open.
Agathe Laisne is from France.
The 2026 Joburg Ladies Open winner finished at 19-under-par.
Agathe Laisne's win was her second Ladies European Tour (LET) title.
The 2026 Joburg Ladies Open was won in a five-hole playoff on April 19, 2026.
The 2026 Joburg Ladies Open playoff was at Randpark Golf Club.
Agathe Laisne defeated Kirsten Rudgeley and Casandra Alexander in the playoff.
The playoff finished in the dark.
The playoff was on the Firethorn course.
Kirsten Rudgeley is from Australia.
Casandra Alexander is from South Africa.
Kirsten Rudgeley was runner-up in the 2026 Joburg Ladies Open.
Casandra Alexander was third place in the 2026 Joburg Ladies Open.
The 2026 Joburg Ladies Open venue was Randpark Golf Club (Firethorn Course), Johannesburg.
The 2026 Joburg Ladies Open dates were April 16–19, 2026.
The 2026 Joburg Ladies Open prize fund was €330,000.
The 2026 Joburg Ladies Open was co-sanctioned by Ladies European Tour (LET) and Sunshine Ladies Tour (SLT).
Agathe Laisne and Kirsten Rudgeley both birdied the 18th in the first playoff hole.
The birdie on the 18th in the first playoff hole eliminated Casandra Alexander.
The 18th hole was shortened to a 78-yard pitch for the final playoff hole.
Agathe Laisne secured a 10-foot birdie putt for the win on the final playoff hole.
Camille Chevalier and Celine Herbin were leading going into the final day of the 2026 Joburg Ladies Open.
Camille Chevalier is from France.
Celine Herbin is from France.
Agathe Laisne and Kirsten Rudgeley surged ahead in the final round of the 2026 Joburg Ladies Open.
Play was briefly delayed during the final round of the 2026 Joburg Ladies Open due to thunder and lightning.
The 2026 Joburg Ladies Open was the 12th edition of the event.
The 2026 Joburg Ladies Open was the 7th stop on the 2026 LET season schedule.
